blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Toon shading renders objects with a flat, stylized appearance. Diffusion models open a new route to this task by transforming photorealistic videos into an anime style. However, existing approaches often rely on curated source and style training pairs or additional visual references. Diffutoon avoids these requirements through structure guidance and colorization, but builds on an image diffusion backbone with short-window motion modules and repeated overlapping-window denoising. We present Diffutoon-2, a video diffusion framework that learns toon shading through animation reconstruction. Two complementary modules independently reconstruct animation clips from outlines and blurred colors, with the video backbone frozen. At inference, the modules jointly guide generation using the same types of conditions extracted from photorealistic footage, requiring neither cross-domain training pairs nor external style references. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Diffutoon-2 outperforms both general-purpose and domain-specific baselines, across quantitative metrics and human evaluation.
blocks.zh: 托恩阴影使物体具有平坦的,结构化的外观. 扩散模型通过将光现实主义视频转化为动漫风格,打开了实现这项任务的新途径. 然而,现有方法往往依赖精密的源头和风格培训对联或额外的视觉参考。 Diffutoon通过结构引导和色化避免了这些要求,但以图像传播主干为基础,有短窗运动模块和重复的重叠窗口去诺化. 我们提出Diffutoon 2, 一个通过动画重建学习卡通阴影的视频传播框架。 两个互补模块独立地从轮廓和模糊的颜色重建动画片段,视频主干部分被冻结. 推论,模块使用从光现实主义镜头中提取的相同类型条件共同引导生成,不需要跨域培训对称或外部风格参考. 广泛的实验表明,Diffutoon-2在定量计量和人类评价方面都优于普通用途和特定领域基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Toon shading is a non-photorealistic rendering task that gives objects a flat, stylized appearance and is widely used in animation production. With the rise of diffusion models, video stylization has provided ways to achieve this appearance from photorealistic footage by rendering it in anime style. The source video supplies the subjects, composition, and motion, while the model transforms texture and shading into the clean outlines and simplified color regions characteristic of anime rendering. This formulation brings toon shading to recorded scenes without requiring explicit 3D representation.
blocks.zh: Toon Shading是一种非相片现实化的渲染任务,它赋予了物体平整,有分层的外观并被广泛用于动画制作. 随着传播模型的兴起,视频分层化通过以动漫风格渲染而提供了从相片现实主义镜头中实现这种外观的方法. 源视频提供主体,组成,和运动,而模型则将纹理和阴影转换为纯洁的轮廓和有线渲染特征的简化色彩区域. 这种提法给所记录的场景带来一卡通阴影而不需要明确的三维表示.

blocks.en: Existing approaches obtain the target appearance through paired supervision or visual references. EchoStyle [ 20 ] constructs source and style video pairs, while PickStyle [ 31 ] uses paired images to synthesize aligned training clips. The reference-guided formulation of Kiwi-Edit [ 25 ] uses reference images during training and inference, whereas AnyV2V [ 18 ] edits the first source frame and propagates its appearance through video generation. These routes introduce two dependencies. Paired supervision requires curated examples that change style while preserving content correspondence. Reference-based generation requires a suitable image whose quality and semantic coverage affect subsequent rendering. In particular, first-frame editing errors can propagate through a video, and scene changes can introduce content that the initial reference does not represent. Diffutoon [ 8 ] repurposes off-the-shelf modules designed for image generation from line art and image super-resolution to provide structure guidance and colorization. However, its image diffusion backbone relies on motion modules with windows of at most 32 frames, while repeated denoising of overlapping windows adds computational cost.
blocks.zh: 现有方法通过配对监督或视觉参考获得目标外观. EchoStyle [20] 构建出源和风格的视频配对,而PickStyle [31] 则使用配对图像来合成对齐的训练剪辑. Kiwi-Edit [25] 的参考指导配方在培训和推论时使用参考图像,而AnyV2V [18] 则编辑了第一个源框,并通过视频生成来宣传其外观. 这些路线引入了两个依赖关系. Paired overritory需要被整理出在保留内容对应性的同时改变风格的例子. 基于参考的生成需要一个合适的图像,其质量和语义覆盖会影响后续渲染. 尤其是一帧编辑错误可以通过视频来传播,场景变化可以引入初始引用不代表的内容. Diffutoon [8] 重用从行艺术和图像超分辨率为图像生成设计的现成模块,提供结构指导和色彩化. 然而,其图像传播主干依赖于最多32个帧的窗口的移动模块,而重复对相重叠的窗口进行去诺则会增加计算成本.

blocks.en: We present Diffutoon-2, a framework that renders photorealistic videos in an anime style by conditioning a video diffusion model on outlines and blurred colors extracted from the input video. The outline video constrains scene structure, while the blurred color video preserves spatial color information and suppresses photographic texture. Both types of supervision are readily available from animation footage itself, since line-art extraction and Gaussian blur each produce a condition paired with the original animation. We use these two forms of supervision to train the structure and colorization modules through animation reconstruction, avoiding the need to generate aligned photorealistic counterparts. The modules are optimized independently with the same backbone kept frozen and composed through residual fusion at inference. At inference, both conditions come directly from the source photorealistic video, eliminating external style references and a separate first-frame editing stage. Generated context supports continuation beyond a single generation window.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Diffutoon 2, 这个框架让照片现实主义的视频呈现出动画风格, 大纲视频会约束场景结构,而模糊的彩色视频会保存空间色彩信息并压制相片纹理. 这两类监督都很容易从动画片段本身获得,因为一行取出和高斯模糊每个片段都会产生与原作动画相配的条件. 我们利用这两种监督形式,通过动画重建来训练结构和色彩化模块,避免产生相通相通的相机. 这些模块是独立优化的,其主干一直被冻结,并通过剩余聚变在推论中构成。 推论,这两个条件都直接出自出自源的相片现实主义视频,取消了外出风格参考和单独的一帧编辑阶段. 生成上下文支持超出单一生成窗口的续作.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows. • We present Diffutoon-2, a technique for toon shading with video diffusion models that renders photorealistic videos in an anime style through structure guidance and colorization. • We formulate complementary animation reconstruction tasks for structure and colorization, enabling independent training and joint control at inference without cross-domain paired supervision or external reference images. • On extensive experiments, Diffutoon-2 outperforms both general-purpose and domain-specific baselines, including the closed-source Seedance2.5, across quantitative metrics and human evaluation.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下。 我们介绍了Diffutoon-2,这是一种用视频传播模型来进行卡通阴影的技术,通过结构取向和色彩化,使相片现实主义视频具有动画风格。 我们为结构和色彩化设计了互补的动画重建任务,从而能够在没有跨域对接监督或外部参考图像的情况下进行独立的培训和共同的推断控制。 在广泛的实验中,Diffutoon-2在定量计量和人类评价方面都超越了普通用途和特定领域基线,包括封闭源种子2.5。

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Generative animation covers stylization, colorization, and motion [ 37 ] . Cartoonization models contours and simplified appearance [ 5 , 39 ] ; diffusion methods colorize animation line art from references [ 3 , 49 ] , propagate colors through grayscale videos [ 28 ] , and render videos [ 9 , 8 ] . FlowStyler [ 13 ] transports geometric and color fields. We learn outline and low-frequency color guidance through animation reconstruction.

blocks.en: Temporal propagation and synchronization support diffusion editing [ 43 , 12 , 18 , 22 , 40 , 38 ] , including local guidance for faces [ 11 ] . Stylization uses text [ 16 , 46 ] , visual references [ 27 , 45 , 48 ] , or broader conditions and modalities [ 21 , 44 ] . Paired supervision supports both stylization [ 31 , 20 ] and editing [ 1 , 30 , 25 ] . Meet-in-Style and StructuReiser [ 19 , 36 ] learn fast networks from stylized examples, with StructuReiser emphasizing structure preservation. We render directly with video diffusion trained through animation-only reconstruction.

We combine outline and low-frequency color guidance with clean latent context for window continuation.

blocks.en: Figure 2 provides an overview of our framework. We first formalize video toon shading as conditional video generation that renders photorealistic inputs in an anime style while preserving their content. We then describe the structure and colorization modules, which learn animation reconstruction from complementary conditions and jointly guide the video diffusion backbone. Finally, we introduce window continuation and prompt construction for rendering videos beyond a single generation window.
blocks.zh: 图2概述了我们的框架。 我们首先将视频卡通阴影正式化,作为有条件的视频生成,使图片现实主义投入具有动画风格,同时保留其内容. 然后我们描述结构和色彩化模块,这些模块从互补条件下学习动画重建,并共同指导视频传播主干线. 最后,我们引入了窗口续作,并迅速构建在单代窗口外渲染视频.

blocks.en: We train separate structure and colorization modules on a private dataset of 15,605 animation clips. We use MiniMax-H3 as the backbone. Both modules adopt a ControlNet architecture [ 47 ] , with nine control blocks corresponding to backbone block IDs 0 , 5 , 10 , 15 , 20 , 25 , 30 , 35 , 40 0,5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40 . Each module is trained for 5,000 steps on eight PPU-ZW810s with 96 GB of memory each, taking approximately 36 hours. We use a batch size of 8, a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and 39-frame clips. Training resolutions preserve the input aspect ratio and are scaled as large as possible without exceeding one million pixels.

blocks.en: We evaluate Diffutoon-2 on 70 photorealistic videos against both open-source and closed-source systems. We randomly select 30 videos from PixaBay100 [ 9 ] and 40 from the combined training and validation sets of DAVIS2017 [ 32 ] . The comparisons include open-source toon shading and video stylization methods ( Diffutoon [ 8 ] , EchoStyle [ 20 ] , and PickStyle [ 31 ] ), open-source video editing and reference-conditioned generation methods ( Kiwi-Edit [ 25 ] , AnyV2V [ 18 ] , and MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA ), and a general-purpose closed-source model ( Seedance2.5 ). We provide MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA with the same outline and color videos as references, allowing us to assess the benefit of our trained modules over direct reference-conditioned generation. All methods target an anime style and are evaluated on corresponding source intervals.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了Diffutoon-2 对70个光现实主义视频 无论是开源还是闭源系统。 我们随机从PixaBay100[9]和DAVIS2017[32]综合训练与验证组合中挑选出30个视频. 比较方法包括:开源通心影和视频分型方法(Diffutoon [8], EchoStyle [20],和PickStyle [31]),开源视频编辑和参考条件生成方法(Kiwi-Edit [25],AnyV2V [18],和MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA),以及通用闭源模型(种子2.5. 我们向MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA提供与参考材料相同的提纲和彩色录像,使我们能够评估我们经过训练的模块相对于直接参考条件的生成的好处。 所有方法都以动能样式为目标,并按相应的源间隔进行评价.

blocks.en: We report nine metrics grouped into content preservation, style and text alignment, and visual and temporal coherence.
blocks.zh: 我们报告分为内容保存、风格和文本统一以及视觉和时间一致性等9个衡量标准。

blocks.en: Content preservation. Line-art Boundary F1-score (Line-F1) measures agreement between outlines extracted from aligned source and generated frames, using binarized line maps and a spatial matching tolerance. Chroma adapts CIEDE2000 by removing lightness differences and applying Gaussian smoothing to the chroma channels. This formulation permits changes in luminance associated with cel shading while measuring the spatial agreement of color. UnifiedReward-Edit (UR-E) [ 6 ] jointly evaluates editing-instruction adherence and source-content preservation.
blocks.zh: 内容保存. 线条艺术 边界 F1-分数(Line-F1) 测量协议 从对齐源取出并生成的帧之间,使用二进制行图和空间相匹配相容性. Chroma通过去除轻度差异并应用高斯平滑来适应CIEDE2000与铬通道. 这种配方允许在测量颜色空间一致度的同时,改变与斜面阴影有关的亮度。 统一奖励-编辑(UR-E) [6] 联合评价编辑-指示遵守和源内容保存.

blocks.en: Style and text alignment. CLIP score [ 34 ] measures agreement between generated frames and the evaluation text. UnifiedReward-2 Style (UR2-S) [ 7 ] assesses aesthetic appeal, while UnifiedReward-2 Alignment (UR2-A) [ 7 ] measures agreement with the described content.
blocks.zh: 样式和文本对齐。 CLIP得分 [34] 生成帧与评价文本之间的计量协议. 统一奖励-2样式(UR2-S)[7]评估审美吸引力,而统一奖励-2对等(UR2-A)[7]与所描述的内容达成措施协议。

blocks.en: Visual and temporal coherence. CSD [ 35 ] measures style consistency between subsequent output frames and the first frame. VBench Motion Smoothness (Smooth) [ 17 ] evaluates motion smoothness on continuous output videos, while UnifiedReward-2 Coherence (UR2-C) [ 7 ] assesses within-frame visual coherence and distortions. For a fair comparison, outputs from all methods are resized to 480p and resampled to 8 fps for evaluation. Details of baseline implementations and metric computation are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 视觉和时间一致性。 CSD [35] 测量后续输出帧和第一个帧之间的样式一致性. V Bench Motion smooth (Smooth) [17] 在连续输出视频上评价运动平滑性,而United Reward-2 Concession (UR2-C) [7] 则评价了范围内的视觉一致性和扭曲性. 为了进行公平的比较,所有方法的输出被调整为480p并被重印为8fps以供评价. 补充材料详细介绍了基线执行情况和衡量标准。

blocks.en: Style and text alignment. Diffutoon-2 leads all three metrics, supporting effective anime stylization with content alignment and aesthetic quality. AnyV2V and MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA obtain the lowest CLIP and UR2-A scores, consistent with their limited transformation of the source’s photographic appearance.
blocks.zh: 样式和文本对齐。 Diffutoon-2领先于所有三个度量衡,支持有效的有内容相接和美学质量的动能分层化. 任意V2V和MiniMax-H3-Ref2 VA获得最低的CLIP和UR2-A分数,这符合他们对来源相片外观的有限转变.

blocks.en: Visual and temporal coherence. Diffutoon-2 achieves the highest CSD and UR2-C scores and ties Seedance2.5 in motion smoothness at the reported precision. These results support coherent rendering within and across frames, consistent with the video backbone’s temporal prior and framewise source guidance.

blocks.en: Figures 1 and 3 show that Diffutoon-2 produces convincing anime renderings while preserving source outlines and colors. Seedance2.5 does not consistently stylize the entire scene, sometimes transforming only foreground objects or retaining a non-anime appearance throughout. EchoStyle, PickStyle, and Kiwi-Edit generate anime-style outputs but introduce larger changes to the source content and lose fine details. Diffutoon preserves source outlines well, but its image-based generation backbone provides weaker color consistency across frames, an observation consistent with its strong Line-F1 and lower CSD scores in Table 1 . AnyV2V and MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA largely retain the original photographic appearance, as shown in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh: 图1和图3显示,Diffutoon-2在保留源轮廓和颜色的同时会产生令人信服的动画渲染. 种子2.5并不连贯地将整个场景分层,有时只转换出前地物体,或在整个过程中保留出非动物外观. EchoStyle,PickStyle,和Kiwi-Edit 生成动画风格的输出,但对源内容引入了更大的修改并丢失了精细的细节. Diffutoon保存了很好的源头轮廓,但其基于图像的生成主干线提供了更弱的跨帧颜色一致性,这个观察与其强大的Line-F1和表1中较低的CSD分数一致. AnyV2V和MiniMax-H3-Ref2 如图3所示,VA基本上保留了最初的相片外观。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: Both ablation studies use Line-F1 for outline preservation, Chroma for color preservation, CLIP for text alignment, and CSD for consistency. Table 2 and Fig. 4 examine the two modules. Structure guidance primarily improves Line-F1, while colorization reduces Chroma error. Their combination at ( 0.5 , 0.5 ) (0.5,0.5) achieves the best outline preservation, color preservation, alignment, and consistency. We find that scale combinations near ( 0.5 , 0.5 ) (0.5,0.5) yield similar results, with further analysis provided in the supplementary material. Figure 4 shows that increasing the structure scale preserves more details, whereas increasing the colorization scale produces colors closer to the source. Without Gaussian filtering during training and inference, the RGB-conditioned variant still retains source colors reasonably well, with a Chroma error of 9.65, but its CLIP score drops from 30.5 to 21.8. Its outputs retain a photographic appearance rather than the desired anime style, supporting the use of low-frequency color conditions.
blocks.zh: 两种通融研究都使用Line-F1来进行大纲保存,Chroma用于色彩保存,CLIP用于文本校正,CSD用于一致性. 表2和图4审查了这两个单元。 结构指导主要改进了"行-F1",而色彩化则会减少克罗玛出错. 它们的组合在 (0.5, 0.5 (0.5, 0.5)) 上实现了最佳的大纲保存,色彩保存,对齐,一致性. 我们发现,接近(0.5,0.5)的尺度组合(0.5,0.5)产生类似的结果,补充材料中提供了进一步的分析。 图4显示,增加结构尺度会保存更多细节,而增加颜色尺度则会产生更接近源的颜色. 在训练和推断期间没有高斯人过滤,RGB有条件的变体仍然保持了合理的源色,Chroma误差为9.65分,但其CLIP分数从30.5分降至21.8分. 其出品保留了相片外观而非所期望的动画风格,支持使用低频取色条件.

blocks.zh: 4.5 人类评价

blocks.en: We randomly select 10 videos from the evaluation set and recruit 30 participants, yielding 300 pairwise comparisons in total. For each video, each participant is shown the output of Diffutoon-2 alongside that of a randomly selected baseline, without revealing the method identities, and rates both results on a scale from 1 to 5. As shown in Table 4 , Diffutoon-2 outperforms all baselines in human preference and achieves the highest mean rating and the lowest standard deviation.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented Diffutoon-2, a video diffusion framework for toon shading that combines structure guidance from outlines with colorization from low-frequency appearance. Both modules are trained independently through animation reconstruction, enabling anime rendering without cross-domain training pairs or external style references. Across 70 photorealistic videos, Diffutoon-2 achieves leading results in content preservation, style and text alignment, and visual and temporal coherence against specialized methods and general-purpose baselines. Human evaluation further favors Diffutoon-2 over every baseline. Ablation studies confirm that complementary structure and low-frequency color guidance preserve source content while enabling anime rendering.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了"Diffutoon-2",这是一款卡通阴影的视频传播框架,它结合了从轮廓得到的结构引导和从低频外观得到的色化. 这两个模块都是通过动画重建独立培训的,使得动画渲染没有跨域培训对等或外部风格参考. Diffutoon-2在70多部摄影现实主义视频中,在内容保存、风格和文本调整、视觉和时间一致性与专门方法和通用基线相比取得了领先成果。 人类评价进一步倾向于Diffutoon-2优于每个基线. 校正研究证实,互补结构和低频色向导保留了源内容,同时能使动ime渲染.

blocks.en: We train the structure and colorization modules separately on the same private dataset of 15,605 animation clips. Each clip is paired with its extracted outlines for structure training and its Gaussian-filtered version for colorization training. The original animation is the reconstruction target in both cases. Each run updates one module with flow matching while keeping the MiniMax-H3 backbone and encoders frozen; the other module is absent. Both modules use nine control blocks corresponding to backbone layers 0 , 5 , 10 , 15 , 20 , 25 , 30 , 35 , 40 0,5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40 .
blocks.zh: 我们在15 605个动画片段的同一套私人数据集上分别培训结构和色彩化模块. 每个片段都配有其结构培训所取取的轮廓和高斯过滤版的彩色化培训. 原作动画在两种情况下都是重建目标. 每次运行都会更新一个相通相匹配的模块,同时使MiniMax-H3主干线和编码器被冻结;另一个模块则没有. 两个模块都使用与主干层对应的9个控制区块:0,5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40 0,5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40.

blocks.en: We use 39-frame clips, a batch size of 8, and a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} . Training preserves the source aspect ratio and uses the largest supported resolution below one million pixels. Each module is trained for 5,000 steps on eight PPU-ZW810s with 96 GB of memory each, taking approximately 36 hours.

blocks.en: Input videos are resampled to 24 fps. Output dimensions preserve the input aspect ratio under a budget of 1,032,192 pixels and are aligned to multiples of 32. blocks.en: Before computing any metric, we resize videos from every method to 480p and sample frames at 8 fps to ensure a fair comparison. Source-dependent metrics use source and generated frames aligned at the same timestamps and spatial coordinates. Whenever a baseline uses a VLM for caption generation, we use Qwen3.8-27B [ 33 ] . All other components and settings follow the original methods. Evaluation text and metric-model settings are shared across methods. MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA receives the outline and blurred color videos as dual video references and uses four denoising steps. Its spatial budget and frame rate match ours. Diffutoon uses ten denoising steps in its main toon-shading pipeline. Table 6 summarizes model sizes and generation settings.

blocks.en: Figures 6 and 7 compare descriptions of two adjacent windows with and without a global reference. Our procedure reuses names for recurring subjects and settings, while allowing each window to describe its own events. In these examples, global guidance retains “heathland” and “tall tapering skyscraper” across windows. Independently generated captions vary the scene description or introduce a specific landmark name in the second window. These excerpts illustrate greater naming consistency; differences in wording alone do not establish incorrect scene content. We show the full global descriptions and the relevant opening sentences of the local captions.
